pre_task_creation_seam.detail: C# SDK v2.2.0 exposes the experimental public McpServerOptions.Filters.Request.CallToolWithAlternateFilters pipeline. WithTasks appends its own alternate-result filter at the current end of that list. Exact docs and source state that alternate-result filters registered before Tasks run before task creation; ordinary CallTool filters run inside Tasks after durable task creation for task-backed calls.
pre_task_creation_seam.implication: A custom alternate-result filter registered before WithTasks can safely short-circuit round 1 with InputRequiredResult/requestState without reaching CreateTaskAsync or the tool. This is the smallest typed request-aware seam found; message filters are lower-level and ordinary AddCallToolFilter is too late.

mrtr_composition_boundary.detail: Tool-body MRTR is not a substitute for the preflight seam: exact WithTasks background execution catches InputRequiredException and records failure with 'MRTR and tasks cannot be composed via [McpServerTool] yet.' The preflight must therefore return InputRequiredResult directly from the pre-Tasks alternate-result filter rather than invoke ElicitAsync/SampleAsync from the task-backed tool body.

deterministic_task_identity.detail: IMcpTaskStore.CreateTaskAsync has no request/idempotency argument, but the custom store itself chooses the unique TaskId. A signed requestState can carry a server-minted op_id bound to method/tool/args/principal/expiry; on execute round, ambient verified identity can make custom CreateTaskAsync atomically create taskId=op_id plus intent metadata. Duplicate creation must fail before WithTasks reaches Task.Run. The pre-Tasks filter catches that conflict, exact-reads the existing task and returns an equivalent CreateTaskResult without invoking Tasks again.
deterministic_task_identity.concurrency: Two identical execute-round retries can both pass the pre-check; atomic create gives one winner. The losing CreateTaskAsync raises before scheduling, the outer filter returns the same existing handle, so only the winner schedules. Mismatching intent/principal for an existing deterministic id fails closed.
deterministic_task_identity.stock_contract_compatibility: IMcpTaskStore requires a unique task id but does not prescribe GUIDs; the bundled InMemoryMcpTaskStore happens to use Guid.NewGuid(). McpTaskInfo.TaskId and CreateTaskResult.TaskId are strings. Deterministic server-minted op_id is therefore compatible with the interface if uniqueness and durable visibility are enforced.

create_before_schedule_gap.detail: Exact RunAsTaskAsync first awaits durable _store.CreateTaskAsync, then installs cancellation state, then calls Task.Run. A process crash after CreateTaskAsync returns but before Task.Run is scheduled leaves a durable Working task with no execution. Deterministic-id response recovery finds and returns that task, but stock WithTasks does not redrive it, so duplicate-safe handle recovery alone can produce a permanent orphan.
create_before_schedule_gap.safety_consequence: Do not classify preflight+deterministic task identity as full crash-safe execution. It closes the unknown-handle/blind-retry duplication window but not the durable-create-to-volatile-schedule liveness window.
create_before_schedule_gap.next_design_requirement: A full protocol needs a durable execution claim/generation or transactional outbox/queue and an effect-bound idempotency/fencing check. If a retry is allowed to re-drive an expired claim, stale attempts must be unable to perform the external effect; stock WithTasks does not expose such a generation in McpTaskInfo or the tool request by itself.

return_existing_handle.detail: CreateTaskResult is public and contains TaskId/status/timestamps/TTL/poll interval/status message. Exact WithTasks private ToCreateTaskResult is a direct field mapping from McpTaskInfo, so the outer filter can reproduce the same wire alternate for a verified existing task using the public ResultOrAlternate.FromAlternate plus serializer metadata.

source_evidence.claim: alternate-result filters before Tasks run before task creation; ordinary filters run in background after task creation
WithTasks appends alternate filter; CreateTaskAsync precedes Task.Run; tool-body InputRequiredException fails; exact ToCreateTaskResult mapping
CreateTaskAsync receives only CancellationToken; implementation chooses unique id and must make it durably visible before return
bundled development store chooses GUID, demonstrating id generation belongs to store implementation
public experimental CallToolWithAlternateFilters compose outside ordinary filters in registration order
requestState-only input_required result is a supported shape
public FromAlternate seam for typed alternate results

executed_artifact.scope: stdlib source-equivalent protocol model; not compiled against the SDK because the local container could not resolve the external network proxy for cloning/restoring packages. Exact SDK source was inspected through the connected GitHub surface.

revision.change: located exact pre-Tasks typed seam; proved deterministic-id duplicate recovery under response loss/concurrent retry; discovered distinct durable-create -> volatile Task.Run orphan window

frontier: At the same exact C# SDK pin, design the smallest durable execution-claim/generation layer that can recover a task created before Task.Run scheduling without allowing a stale or concurrent attempt to perform the external effect. Separate handle recovery, execution liveness, and effect exactly-once/idempotency as three independent properties.

Determine whether an ordinary pre-tool filter plus AsyncLocal/request-scoped generation can carry a custom store claim into the Task.Run execution and fail stale attempts before the tool; then construct a counterexample for lease expiry during a non-idempotent external effect. Prefer a real effect-side idempotency/CAS key over process-local fencing.
Convert the OpenHands v1.44.1 fenced pending-commit marker model into an exact-source patch/regression candidate preserving current unmatched-Action startup repair and intentional forks.

Audit another mutating open-source API with caller-supplied stable creation identity plus exact lookup/CAS, and check whether the connected Chat surface exposes the needed mutation/readback primitives.
